hero.title: Find your people in Dhaka
hero.subtitle: Bondhu Circle matches you into a small circle of 4–6 people who share your interests and free time — then gives you a reason to meet up every week.
hero.imageAlt: Friends laughing together over coffee at a Dhaka café

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three small steps, and then you are meeting real people.
how.step1Text: Pick your interests, your neighbourhood and the times you are usually free.
how.step2Text: Every week we form small circles of people who actually match — same zone, same interests.
how.step3Text: Vote on the time, RSVP, and meet at a vetted café, park or court near you.

categories.title: Things your circle can do
categories.subtitle: Every activity is hosted by a trained community host and approved before it goes live.

safety.title: Safety is the product
safety.text: Friendship only works when people feel safe. Every part of Bondhu is built around that.
safety.point1Text: Everyone verifies a real phone number before joining an activity or a circle.
safety.point2Text: Venues stay private until you are confirmed for the meetup.
safety.point3Title: Report and block in one tap
safety.point3Text: Report anyone or anything. Blocked people never share a circle with you.
safety.point4Text: Every host application and every activity is reviewed by a human.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: A circle is 4–6 people in your part of Dhaka with overlapping interests and availability. You keep the same circle for weeks, so friendships have time to become real.
faq.a2: Joining Bondhu Circle is free. Some activities have a small cost (coffee, court rental) paid directly at the venue.
faq.q3: Do I have to be from Dhaka?
faq.a3: For now, yes. We only operate in four Dhaka zones: Dhanmondi/Mohammadpur, Gulshan/Banani, Mirpur and Uttara.
faq.q4: What if my circle is not a fit?
faq.a4: You can leave a circle at any time and request a new one. Nobody is stuck with anyone.
faq.a5: Yes. Turn on “women only” in your preferences and you will only be matched into women-only circles and activities.
faq.a6: Yes — apply to host from the Host page. A real person reviews every application.

cta.title: Your weekly circle starts this week
cta.text: It takes about two minutes to set up your profile. The next matching run happens every Monday.

footer.note: Bondhu Circle is a community platform for meeting people in real life — not a dating app.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Before we go further, please read and accept these.
guidelines.rule1: Show up when you say you will, or cancel early.
guidelines.rule2: Treat everyone with respect — no harassment, no slurs, no romantic pressure.
guidelines.rule3: Keep what is shared in the circle inside the circle.
guidelines.rule4: Meet in public places. Alcohol and illegal activity are not welcome at Bondhu meetups.
guidelines.rule5: Report anything that feels off. We read every report.
guidelines.accept: I have read and accept the guidelines
guidelines.acceptError: Please accept the guidelines to continue.
